A '''Narrow-Beam Broadcast Projector''' was a component used in [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]]. [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav's]] [[XXt-26 S-thread tracker]] had several projectors installed into the device.<ref name="EGWT" />
